Dear [Mr Craik](/person/379)
Thanks for the [estimate](/topic/160) of the copyrights, which is a good deal what I expected, as I thought they must be more valuable to me than to anyone else.
I cannot think what [Clay](/organisation/173) is about. A month ago he wrote to me in a great hurry for more copy of the [Cameos](/book/124) saying you wanted the third volume finished, I sent him up at once all but the last two or three chapters which are now ready, and nothing more have I heard of them - no proofs nor any sign of his going on.
I do not think it was quite settled what I was to have for [My Young Alcides](/book/112). I should be glad to know.

Yours truly

C M Yonge
